rule.pattern: give_up category=.*at turn 1[0-9]|cost \$0\.[1-9].*requires.*API key|requires.*GPU.*inference|requires.*credentials|gated.*Matterport|excluded from the release
rule.advice: Detect hard blockers (GPU, API keys, gated data, missing release assets) by turn 3: read README and check for required external resources. If any target metric is unachievable without blocked resources, give up by turn 5 with a clear explanation. Do not spend >$0.05 exploring workarounds.

BrokenPipeError in notebook cell inspection means stdout was closed early (e.g. piped to head). Use python3 script writing to a file instead: redirect output with '> /tmp/out.txt' or use sys.stdout.flush(). Avoid piping large python -c output through shell pipes.

grep returns exit code 1 when no lines match, causing nonzero exit. Append '|| true' to grep/xargs commands, or use 'grep ... || echo NO_MATCH'. Never rely on grep exit code to gate subsequent logic when zero matches is a valid outcome.

www.openml.org is blocked. Use allowed alternatives: archive.ics.uci.edu, huggingface.co, or zenodo.org. For Mice Protein: wget 'https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/00342/Data_Cortex_Nuclear.xls'. Map dataset IDs to UCI/HF equivalents immediately.

api.github.com is blocked at runtime. Do NOT call GitHub API for release assets or metadata. Check if files exist locally under /work/repo first. If release assets are required and absent, document as data_unavailable and give up early (turn <=5).

Cap exploration at 5 turns. After reading README + 2-3 key files, write and run a script immediately. Do not chain cat/head/grep across many turns. Use one python3 script to inspect repo structure programmatically. If no script is running by turn 6, commit to best-guess implementation now.

JSON parse failure on API response usually means the proxy returned an HTML error page, not JSON. First check raw response: curl -s URL | head -5. If proxy blocks the host, stop and use an alternative source. Never pipe blocked-host curl output directly into python json.load.

rule.advice: Never submit a shell cell containing only comments or whitespace. Always include at least one executable command (e.g., 'echo ok' or 'ls /work/'). Comment-only cells hang indefinitely waiting for input.

rationale: Key patterns: (1) openml.org is consistently blocked despite being in the allowlist regex—needs explicit fallback advice to UCI/HF. (2) api.github.com is blocked at runtime for release asset fetching. (3) Late give-up at turn 16 wastes budget; enforce early detection. (4) turn_budget_exhausted from excessive reading without running—reinforce the existing rule with stronger wording. (5) BrokenPipeError from piping large python output. (6) JSON parse errors from piping blocked-host responses. The controller is not added since the existing rules cover the main patterns; the egress and late_give_up issues are primarily advice problems.

controller.rationale: Enforce early execution: builders are spending 15+ turns reading without running. run_by_turn=5 forces first execution attempt early; script_by_turn=8 ensures a complete script exists before mid-point. This addresses the turn_budget_exhausted and late_give_up clusters.

controller_gate: bounds ok; projected worst-case builder cost $0.30
